description: React component for logged-in user interface, managing WebSocket connections, user activity, focus/blur events, and navigation redirects based on authentication and MFA status.

classes.name: LoggedIn
classes.description: React component handling user session, WebSocket management, focus/blur events, and navigation redirects.

methods.name: isValidState
methods.description: Checks if currentUser prop is not null.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Initializes WebSocket, sets up event listeners, fetches user profile attributes, and manages device-specific classes.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Cleans up WebSocket connection and event listeners.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders loading screen, redirects for MFA or Terms of Service, or children components.

methods.name: updateTimeZone
methods.description: Updates user's timezone based on browser settings.

methods.name: onFocusListener
methods.description: Handles window focus event, updates timezone, and emits focus state.

methods.name: onBlurListener
methods.description: Handles window blur event and emits focus loss.

methods.name: updateActiveStatus
methods.description: Updates user activity status via WebSocket.

methods.name: clickNotification
methods.description: Handles notification click, focuses window, and navigates to channel.

methods.name: handleBackSpace
methods.description: Prevents backspace navigation in non-input elements.

methods.name: handleBeforeUnload
methods.description: Handles cleanup before page unload, updates view time, and closes WebSocket.
